Also check the coil supply: the valve is rated for 24V DC, 230V 50/60 Hz or 115V 50/60 Hz with a voltage tolerance of ±10 %, and the type plate's voltage and current type must be observed — a wrong or out-of-tolerance supply voltage (or a coil set mismatched to the supply, e.g. the 110V AC vs 230V AC vs 24V DC coil sets) could cause hum without opening. If the valve still fails, consult the maintenance notes: maintenance must be done only by authorized specialists, the valve secured against unintentional operation, and a controlled restart performed afterwards, following the installation manual (available with the product and at www.gfps.com/is-manuals-valves).
